A passionate, professional holistic therapist with 17 years experience. Sharing relaxing treatment tutorials, therapist education, gentle anatomy insight, and practical follow along sessions.

This is a space for rest, learning, and wellbeing through real therapeutic techniques. I create these videos alongside my full-time therapy practice, sharing treatments that feel calming, educational, and true to everyday therapy work.

Thank you for being here ♡
